description: Surgically replace a substring inside a Text or Table DAT's `.text`. Without `replace_all`, requires exactly one match — 0 or >1 occurrences is an error, forcing the caller to add context or set `replace_all`. Use `set_dat_content` to overwrite an entire DAT's text in place; use this to make a targeted edit. Because DAT text can become executable callbacks, this tool is hidden when TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=off and the bridge also requires TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1 for writes.

dat_path.description: Absolute path to the Text or Table DAT to edit (e.g. '/project1/mytext1').

new_string.description: Replacement text. May be empty to delete the matched substring.

old_string.description: Exact substring to find. Must match at least once. Empty strings are rejected.

replace_all.description: When false (default), requires exactly one match — 0 or >1 occurrences is an error. Set true to replace every occurrence.

name: edit_dat_content
title: Edit DAT content (surgical)
